catalog.method: Plain HTTP GET, no headers; body is one Argon2id (t=3, m=8192 KiB, p=1, 32 B) + AES-256-GCM envelope (AAD=salt) -> JSON UTF-8
catalog.notes: Catalog shape: {catalog_version, app_version, app_version_name, app_url, app_msg, servers, configs}. The broker uses a dedicated downloader (downloadMsyVpn) because the endpoint is plain HTTP; the same fixed URL is already used by S Tunnel via supplied. No own file format or text scheme (clipboard only).
